描述_ZN: The scroll of "Poem in Official Script", Qing Dynasty, written by Ba Weizu on paper, in official script, 125 cm in length and 48.3 cm in width.　　This scroll contains a poem in five lines. Ba Weizu's clerical script is nourished by the bell and tripod of the Shang Dynasty and the stone inscriptions of the Qin and Han Dynasties, taking its ancient and simple artistic style and influenced by the clerical script of his contemporary Deng Shiru, which is characterized by its dangerous and vigorous brushwork.　　Commentary: Spring River floats shallow islets, going to live at will flying Hong. Bald pipe edge is thick, dumb money debt is not empty. I know that all of us are dreaming, but I dare not ask the God of Heaven. I read it with my hand, and I am waiting for a compromise. The yellow magnetic bamboo is used to cut, and the white jade goblet is rewarded. Every year, two or three more sticks are placed on the festival. Jundang Jushi.　　Signed "Juntang Jushi", with two seals in vermilion, "Dewei Zhai Seal" and "Ba's comforting ancestor". The seal of the collection is inscribed as "Jianzhai's review" in vermilion.
